sailor-dialogue.adaptation: Shortened speech; changed wardrobe, dialogue and shot progression.
sailor-dialogue.coverage: human face, speech and environmental sound

night-bus.adaptation: Added a small expression change and a five-second audio scene.
night-bus.coverage: skin detail, glass reflection and moving light

candy-keyboard.section: Fuse visuals with sound design: candy keyboard example
candy-keyboard.adaptation: Fixed three presses and a steady close camera.
candy-keyboard.coverage: fingertips, small-object motion and synchronized foley

canyon-reveal.adaptation: Limited camera travel to one short reveal.
canyon-reveal.coverage: wide scene, camera motion and fine landscape structure

rose-raindrop.adaptation: Added one rolling drop and a clear endpoint.
rose-raindrop.coverage: macro texture, transparent liquid and motion

clay-campfire-fox.section: Subject examples: campfire and curious fox; artistic style examples
clay-campfire-fox.adaptation: New clay-animation staging with one simple interaction.
clay-campfire-fox.coverage: stylized animation, two subjects and music

field-mouse.adaptation: Expanded an image-conditioned motion cue into standalone text and sound.
field-mouse.coverage: animal anatomy, fur and tracking camera

umbrella-opening.adaptation: Converted reference-image example to standalone text and five seconds.
umbrella-opening.coverage: hands, object state change and rain foley

selection: Broaden subjects, composition, motion and audio while fitting five seconds and requiring no reference media. All choices precede generation.
authorship: New prompt prose is written for this benchmark. Linked examples are inspiration, not verbatim prompt copies. Google Cloud documentation adaptations retain CC BY 4.0 attribution; external authors do not endorse this benchmark.
format_reference: minimax-h3-guide: three audiovisual fields, one Shot 1 and native dialogue tags.
boundary: Source example quality on another model is not evidence of H3 output quality. No model weights or reference videos were downloaded.
